name: Driver
definition: A person who competes in Formula 1 race events, identified by a permanent driver identifier.
scope: Driver-level identity across races, results, qualifying, lap times, pit stops and standings.

name: Constructor
definition: A team or manufacturer entering cars in Formula 1 race events, identified by a permanent constructor identifier.
scope: Constructor-level identity across results, qualifying and standings.

name: Race
definition: A single Grand Prix event held on a specific date within a season, identified by a permanent race identifier.
scope: Race-level identity and the join point between seasons, circuits, drivers, constructors and results.

name: Circuit
definition: A permanent racing venue at which race events are held, identified by a permanent circuit identifier.
scope: Venue identity, host location and geographic coordinates.

name: Season
definition: A championship year that groups the race events held within it.
scope: Time-based grouping and filtering of races, results and standings by championship year.

name: Race Result Entry
definition: The record of one driver's participation in one race: starting position, final classification, laps, points and outcome status.
scope: Analytical grain for per-driver, per-race performance and outcome questions.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: The complete personal name of a driver, expressed as the given name together with the family name.
scope: Used when a question addresses a driver by a natural-language personal name rather than by an identifier or reference name.

name: Driver Reference Name
definition: A short, stable, human-readable slug that uniquely identifies a driver across the dataset.
scope: Used when a question asks for a driver's reference name rather than their personal name.

name: Driver Nationality
definition: The sporting nationality attributed to a driver, expressed as a country adjective or country name.
scope: Filtering and grouping of drivers by nation.

name: Driver Date of Birth
definition: The calendar date on which a driver was born.
scope: Age comparison, birth-year range filtering and seniority questions.

name: Driver Age
definition: The elapsed time between a driver's date of birth and a comparison date; larger date-of-birth values denote younger drivers.
scope: Questions phrased in terms of oldest or youngest driver.

name: Constructor Nationality
definition: The sporting nationality attributed to a constructor, expressed as a country adjective or country name.
scope: Filtering and grouping of constructors by nation.

name: Race Name
definition: The published title of a Grand Prix event, such as a national or host-named event title.
scope: Identifying a race by its event title; the title alone does not identify a unique event because it recurs across seasons.

name: Circuit Location
definition: The named place or settlement in which a circuit is situated.
scope: Descriptive location of a venue, distinct from its geographic coordinates.

name: Circuit Coordinates
definition: The geographic coordinate pair of a circuit, comprising a latitude and a longitude, optionally accompanied by an altitude.
scope: Positional questions about a venue or about the venue hosting a race.

name: Circuit Country
definition: The country in which a circuit is located, which is the host nation of any race held there.
scope: Questions about the number or list of events held in a given country.

name: Finish Position
definition: The final classification position of a driver in a race, together with the ordering that places every entrant including those that did not complete the distance.
scope: Ranking, champion/runner-up identification, and last-placed-driver questions.

name: Grid Position
definition: The starting position from which a driver began a race.
scope: Questions about where a driver started rather than where they finished.

name: Race Classification Status
definition: The categorical outcome recorded for a race entry, distinguishing a numeric classification from retirement, disqualification, exclusion, withdrawal, or failure to qualify.
scope: Determining whether a driver is treated as having finished, retired or otherwise not been classified.

name: Race Finish Time
definition: The time recorded for a driver at the end of a race, expressed either as an absolute elapsed time from the start of the race or, for drivers behind the winner, as an incremental gap added to the winner's elapsed time.
scope: Finish-time questions, winner time questions and fastest-versus-slowest comparisons.

name: Incremental Time Gap
definition: The margin by which a driver trails the race winner, representing the accumulated time difference rather than an absolute elapsed time.
scope: Comparisons of pace between the winner and any other classified finisher.

name: Elapsed Race Time in Milliseconds
definition: The absolute elapsed race time of a driver expressed as a whole number of milliseconds, representing the same total as the winner-style absolute finish time but in a numerically comparable unit.
scope: Arithmetic on finish times, such as computing gaps, totals and percentage differences.

name: Race Points
definition: The championship points scored by a driver or by a constructor in a single race event.
scope: Per-race scoring questions, including identifying entries that scored no points in a given race.

name: Standings Points
definition: The cumulative championship points accumulated by a driver or constructor up to and including a given race of a season.
scope: Championship-progress questions, distinct from points scored in a single race.

name: Standings Position
definition: The championship ranking of a driver or constructor at the point in the season represented by a standings record.
scope: Championship-table questions covering drivers and constructors.

name: Race Winner
definition: The driver classified first in a race, referred to in workload language as the champion of that race.
scope: Identifying the victor of a specific race and comparing that driver against the rest of the field.

name: Race Outcome Status
definition: The categorical reason recorded for how a driver's race ended, covering completion, mechanical failure, incident, disqualification and other outcomes.
scope: Outcome-based filtering and counting of race entries.

name: Accident Outcome
definition: The race outcome category describing an entry that ended because the driver was involved in an accident, as distinguished from a collision, a fatal accident, a mechanical failure or a disqualification.
scope: Counting and filtering entries by accident involvement.

name: Qualifying Result
definition: The record of one driver's qualifying performance for one race, including that driver's qualifying position and the times set in each qualifying period.
scope: Qualifying-specific analysis and joining qualifying performance to race results.

name: Qualifying Period
definition: One of the successive timed segments of a qualifying session, ordered so that later segments contain only drivers who progressed from earlier ones.
scope: Questions that reference a first, second or third qualifying period and the times recorded in them.

name: Qualifying Elimination
definition: The outcome in which a driver does not progress beyond a given qualifying period and therefore records no time in any later period.
scope: Questions identifying drivers eliminated at a particular stage of qualifying.

name: Lap Time
definition: The time taken by a driver to complete one lap of a race, recorded per lap together with a numerically comparable duration value.
scope: Per-lap pace analysis and identification of laps matching a given duration.

name: Fastest Lap
definition: The quickest lap recorded by a driver within a race, together with the lap number on which it was set and the identity of the driver who set the quickest lap of the whole race.
scope: Fastest-lap questions at driver level and at race level.

name: Fastest Lap Speed
definition: The average speed achieved on a driver's fastest lap, recorded as a numeric quantity expressed in kilometres per hour.
scope: Speed-based comparisons within a race or across all races.

name: Pit Stop
definition: A single recorded visit by a driver to the pit lane during a race, identified by the race, the driver and the stop sequence number.
scope: Pit-lane activity analysis per driver, per race or per season.

name: Pit Stop Duration
definition: The elapsed time a driver spent stationary during a pit stop, recorded as a duration in seconds.
scope: Questions about pit stop speed, including average duration per driver.

name: Reference Website URL
definition: A reference web address published for an entity in the dataset, serving as that entity's introduction or profile page.
scope: Questions asking for a driver's, constructor's or circuit's introduction website or reference link.
